work_or_witness: VIZ Volume 1 product synopsis and official series description
description: A young would-be pirate inspired by the buccaneer Red-Haired Shanks, who accidentally eats the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit, gains the ability to stretch like rubber, loses the ability to swim, and leaves alone in a rowboat to seek the One Piece and become King of the Pirates.

roles_and_vocations.note: VIZ directly states Luffy vows/dreams to become a pirate and King of the Pirates; this is an opening aspiration, not an achieved title or a real-world role equivalence.

power_traditions.note: VIZ directly attributes Luffy's rubber-like stretching power to accidental consumption of the named fruit; no complete Devil Fruit system is inferred.

states_and_transformations.term: rubber-like stretching and inability to swim
states_and_transformations.note: Direct VIZ premise wording; no medical diagnosis, physics claim, or later ability development is asserted.

artifacts_and_vehicles.note: VIZ describes the opening departure as Luffy alone in a rowboat; no later ship/crew is inferred.

narrative_archetypes.note: The stated initial objective is the legendary One Piece, said by VIZ to be the greatest treasure in the world.

canon_status: Named central individual directly described by the selected VIZ English Volume 1 metadata.

supports: Monkey D. Luffy/Luffy names, Shanks inspiration, Gum-Gum Devil Fruit, rubber stretching, inability to swim, pirate-king aspiration, rowboat, and One Piece objective

comparison_cautions: Piracy and the King-of-the-Pirates aspiration are source-specific fictional adventure roles, not a historical-piracy, colonial, maritime-law, or criminality equivalence.
The ability/cost premise does not establish a complete Devil Fruit category, Haki, later transformations, combat capacity, crew, origin, family, or ending.

Hazardous seafaring, inability to swim, adventure violence, and later colonial/oppression themes are not expanded into claims beyond the narrow VIZ premise; no anime, game, novel, guidebook, live-action, or later manga content is used.

description: The buccaneer called Red-Haired Shanks, whose tales inspire the child Luffy to become a pirate.
